reference.title: Simvastatin but not pravastatin is very susceptible to interaction with the CYP3A4 inhibitor itraconazole.
reference.abstract: Itraconazole greatly increased serum concentrations of simvastatin, simvastatin acid, and HMG CoA reductase inhibitors, probably by inhibiting CYP3A-mediated metabolism, but it had only a minor effect on pravastatin. Concomitant use of potent inhibitors of CYP3A with simvastatin should be avoided or its dosage should be greatly reduced.
